mainEntity.name: Are smile makeovers for men different from those for women?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are important aesthetic differences. Men generally suit broader, squarer tooth shapes, slightly warmer or more muted shades, and a flatter smile arc. The design of any cosmetic treatment should take into account masculine facial proportions, jawline structure, and lip shape. An experienced cosmetic dental professional will tailor every aspect of the makeover to ensure results look natural and complement your individual features rather than applying a generic approach.

mainEntity.name: How long does a smile makeover take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe depends entirely on the treatments involved. Simple procedures such as teeth whitening or composite bonding may be completed in one or two appointments. More complex makeovers involving veneers, crowns, or orthodontic treatment may take several weeks to several months. During your initial consultation, your dental professional can provide a realistic timeline based on your specific treatment plan and clinical needs.

mainEntity.name: Will people be able to tell I have had dental work done?

acceptedAnswer.text: When a smile makeover is well-planned and skilfully executed, the results should look entirely natural. The goal is for people to notice that your smile looks great — not that you have had treatment. This is achieved through careful attention to tooth shape, colour, translucency, and proportion, ensuring everything harmonises with your natural features. Communicating your preference for subtle results during the planning stage is important.

Most cosmetic dental treatments involve minimal discomfort. Procedures such as bonding and whitening are generally painless. Veneers and crowns may require some tooth preparation, which is carried out under local anaesthetic so you should not feel pain during the procedure. Any mild sensitivity following treatment typically resolves within a few days. Your dental professional will explain what to expect at every stage.

mainEntity.name: How long do the results of a smile makeover last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The longevity of results varies by treatment. Porcelain veneers can last 10 to 15 years or longer with proper care. Composite bonding may last 5 to 10 years before requiring maintenance or replacement. Teeth whitening results can be maintained with good oral hygiene and occasional top-up treatments. The most important factors in preserving your results are consistent oral hygiene, regular dental visits, and avoiding habits that place excessive stress on your teeth.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to have all treatments done at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. A smile makeover can be phased over time, allowing you to address priorities first and spread the commitment. Some patients begin with whitening or bonding before progressing to veneers or alignment treatment. Your dental professional can help you develop a treatment plan that suits your goals, timeline, and budget, ensuring each phase builds towards the overall result you are hoping to achieve.
